scripts.dev: node scripts/stack-versions.js; CLAY_STACK_CHECKED=1 npm run dev -w @cswg/clay-studio
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cswg/clay-chat && npm run build -w @cswg/clay-studio
scripts.start: node scripts/stack-versions.js; CLAY_STACK_CHECKED=1 npm run start -w @cswg/clay-studio
